claims.title: Explicit unramified lifting and exact completion comparison
claims.statement: For an unramified number-field prime P over p of residue degree m, construct a Good embedding into Q_m=Frac(W(F_(p^m))). Conversely, every such Good embedding identifies the actual completion with Q_m and its integer ring with W_m, compatibly with the original number field.
assumptions: The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.

Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.

BC1-BC3 are prior proved results supplying the actual finite coefficient extension, its chosen-place embedding and the exact ramification scaling. Their proofs are reused, not reasserted as new LI claims.
All local lattices and levels are the literal supplied ColLevel/LevelData objects. A frame for each completion does not by itself construct a common global matrix B.
The global class-rank equality and comparison-lattice identification remain separate. No full IsLocalFamily, GroupCompatibilityAll, linked family, RH or GRH conclusion is asserted here.
For the forward direction the prime is unramified; for the converse the three literal Good clauses are given. The converse itself implies unramifiedness.
claims.source_relation: A Newton/simple-root power-basis proof replaces the source formal-etale Witt lifting. The converse uses the exact local-integrality criterion and identical quotients at every p-power precision, not an unsupported density-to-isomorphism inference.

Level-zero additive-character values and their inverses are algebraic integers. Their unique coefficient-field lifts map to units of ORec; psi(a)=embRec(r(K(a)))^(-1) is a homomorphism satisfying every quantifier in PsiTied. These choices are simultaneous with LI7, whose posOK holds for every psi.

prior_components_reused.role: Actual standard Witt/quadratic coefficient field, finite normalization, prescribed-place embedding, faithful integral transport and exact ramification normalization.

same_iteration_companions.role: Independent concrete host/point transport branch. LI consumes the stated Host laws; it does not infer that branch's global hypotheses from local identifications.

boundary_resolved.scope: Full literal local record, all primes above p, actual lattice frame, original coefficient embedding and every-position parity compatibility, for supplied D7/host/level data and GIdx.
Actual local-prime membership and normalized valuations for the supplied theta_g coefficient embedding dictionary; no global comparison lattice inferred.
Actual ORec-unit character under supplied Joint0 and LevelZeroCharacterRational, simultaneous with the local-position construction.

scope_precision: The finite abelian group A is the actual R.MA; no cyclicity assumption is inserted.
The arithmetic Frobenius convention is residue x->x^p; same-prime embeddings satisfy g'=g f^s with the source multiplication convention.
The orbit quotient labels all F-primes above p. Even ord(h) excludes c from <f> and makes E/F split despite the name inertClass.
Position compatibility includes c^s at odd positions and uses the original embRec. The Good embedding is adjusted before the prime enumeration is chosen.
The projected lattice is the literal locL(Lc.Lb), not an abstract full lattice chosen independently. Its local frame need not descend to one global B.
Only nu_w/nu_w(p) is identified with the Witt p-valuation; integral valuations may scale under ramification. The zero case is included separately in prime membership.
PsiTied is proved for every compatible kappa by truncation uniqueness, and psi takes values in ORec units, using integrality also of inverses.
The classical Hensel/completion construction is a human replacement argument, not a claimed formalized Lean replacement or kernel replay.
retained_inputs: The supplied Host/HostDer/HostAx fields, including their conductor and arithmetic Frobenius laws; their global construction and suitable-prime abundance.
The supplied D7, ColLevel/LevelData and coefficient embedding dictionaries; LI does not construct the global arithmetic representation or host.
Joint0 and LevelZeroCharacterRational for the level-zero forms in the away-character endpoint.
StdTied plus Companion and the standard-frame supply, pack_d_eq, and the actual comparison_statements/ValIntRec/comparison_lattice_span_eq branch. LI constructs the individual LocId records only.
All separate global theta/period, spectral, cohomological-window and analytic conclusions required for RH or GRH.
independent_review_targets: LI1-LI3 Hensel uniqueness, exact completion converse, Frobenius degree and every-prime CRT/ideal contraction classification
LI4-LI6 original coefficient alignment, c^s parity, actual lattice projection, normalized valuation and zero branch
LI7-LI8 exact GIdx specialization, character rationality/unit proof and simultaneous-family scope
